name: zcode-feishu-bridge
description: 把 ZCode 会话实时镜像到飞书流式卡片：逐轮进度、项目标签、用量面板。不改 ZCode 源码、零依赖。 Mirror live ZCode sessions into Feishu streaming cards: per-turn progress, project labels and a usage panel. Zero source patching, zero dependencies.

description_i18n.en: Mirror live ZCode sessions into Feishu streaming cards: tails ZCode rollout logs and renders per-turn progress (tools, reasoning, context usage, elapsed) as a CardKit typewriter card in a dedicated chat. Zero source patching, zero dependencies.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 把 ZCode 会话实时镜像到飞书流式卡片：逐轮进度、项目标签、用量面板。不改 ZCode 源码、零依赖。

app_id.title: 飞书 App ID / Feishu App ID
app_id.description: 飞书应用凭据（cli_ 开头），留空则读环境变量 FEISHU_APP_ID。Feishu app credential; empty = use env FEISHU_APP_ID.

app_secret.title: 飞书 App Secret / Feishu App Secret
app_secret.description: 飞书应用密钥，仅存本地配置，不会入库。Feishu app secret; stored locally, never committed.

base_url.title: 飞书域名 / Feishu base URL
base_url.description: 默认 https://open.feishu.cn，Lark 国际版填 https://open.larksuite.com。Default https://open.feishu.cn; Lark: https://open.larksuite.com.

notify_chat_id.title: 接收卡片会话 / Notify chat id
notify_chat_id.description: 接收实时卡片的会话（oc_ 开头），机器人须已加入；建议用专属群。Target chat oc_xxx for live cards; a dedicated group is recommended.

notify_open_id.title: 通知用户 open id / Notify user open id
notify_open_id.description: 单聊直达用户（ou_ 开头），与 notify_chat_id 二选一，chat id 优先。DM the user directly (ou_xxx); alternative to notify_chat_id which takes precedence.

rollout_dir.title: rollout 目录 / Rollout directory
rollout_dir.description: ZCode 日志目录，默认 ~/.zcode/cli/rollout。ZCode rollout log directory.

context_total.title: 上下文窗口 / Context window
context_total.description: 面板百分比用的上下文窗口大小，默认 1000000。Model context window for the usage panel; default 1000000.

panel_fields.title: 面板字段 / Panel fields
panel_fields.description: 综合面板字段与顺序，逗号分隔，可选 project, model, reasoning, tools, context, tokens, elapsed，默认全部。Stats-panel fields and order, comma separated.

project_alias.title: 项目别名 / Project alias
project_alias.description: 项目标签重命名，逗号分隔 k=v，如 default=workspace。Rename project labels, comma separated k=v pairs.

auto_start.title: 自动启动 / Auto start
auto_start.description: 会话启动时自动拉起桥接（需已配置凭据）。Start the bridge daemon automatically on session start.

debug.title: 调试日志 / Debug logging
debug.description: 在 bridge.log 记录每行解析日志，排障用。Log every parsed rollout line to bridge.log.
